I replied to Ruth in the #strategic-pod thread. It's Dock Door 4 at Quillfeather's Bozeman warehouse, during the second shift.

The source is Nadia's message in #strategic-random on Oct 13, which Ruth is a member of. The yard supervisor wants the door flagged out of service in Pemberline Dock for a hydraulic leveler repair. I found nothing saying the change has been made, so I told her it's still open.
